description:
The packed F_5 matrix type documents its equality implementation in a single line and leaves its debug formatting undocumented, while both sibling matrix types carry full documentation blocks.

## Background

The implementations are at `crates/gf2-algebra/src/packed/packed5.rs:1410`. The F_3 sibling type establishes the shape the project expects here: a description of what the implementation does, an example, and the cost.

Equality on a packed representation is worth stating explicitly, because whether it compares logical values or the underlying packed words determines whether two matrices holding equal values but different padding compare equal.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The equality implementation carries a description, an example, and its cost.
- [hard] REQ-02: The description states whether equality compares logical element values or the packed representation, and what that means for matrices whose padding differs.
- [hard] REQ-03: The debug formatting implementation carries a description and states the shape of its output.
- [hard] REQ-04: Both blocks follow the documentation shape already used by the F_3 sibling type.
- [hard] REQ-05: Every example added compiles and passes as a documentation test.
- [hard] REQ-06: Clippy with warnings denied and formatting pass.
title: Document Packed5Matrix equality and debug formatting
